_about: Footprint patch for GEO.buildings, written by pipeline/footprints.py and applied in src/core/geo.js. "replace" gives a new shape to an existing index (part 0 of a split). "append" parts are added at the END of the array, so no existing index moves. "skip" marks indices that are not buildings (their polygon is emptied). src: streetview | satellite+cls | estimated.
